prompt: I need to prepare for a 3-day trip to New York next month. List 5 essential items I should pack, in order of importance.

success_criteria.judge_prompt: Score 0–1: Does the list contain 5 reasonable items, ordered sensibly by importance (e.g. passport/ID first, then clothes, charger, meds, etc.)? 1 = logical & complete, 0 = irrelevant or missing basics.
